gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: onset of vomiting 3 days ago. Generated facts mention vomiting only in the chief complaint as 2 episodes now resolved, and do not state onset 3 days ago.

Gold: diarrhea has now developed and occurs 5–6 times/day. Generated chief complaint states a 3-day history of watery diarrhea ~5–6/day, which differs in timing (3-day history vs 'has now developed'); no generated HPI fact states this as a new development. Temporal relationship is not captured.

Gold: stools are watery and loose. Generated facts describe watery diarrhea in chief complaint, but not stool consistency specifically in the HPI; no generated HPI fact captures 'watery/loose stools' wording.
Gold: no blood in stools, no abdominal pain. Generated HPI-004 (denies abdominal pain) and HPI-005 (denies blood in stool) together capture this.

Gold: reduced oral intake, not drinking sufficient fluids, feels dehydrated. Generated HPI-001 captures feeling dehydrated, and HPI-002 captures decreased oral intake/appetite, but does not explicitly state 'not drinking sufficient fluids'. That specific element is omitted.
Gold: appetite is reduced. Generated HPI-002 states decreased appetite, which matches.
Gold: no fever but feels warm and weak. Generated HPI-003 captures weakness and HPI-006 captures no current fever, but does not mention 'feels warm'. That symptom is omitted.
Gold: no headaches or muscle pain. Generated HPI-007: denies headache or myalgia. This aligns.
Gold: unaware of any triggers and no unwell contacts. No generated fact mentions triggers or sick contacts.
Gold: history of asthma. Generated PMH-001 matches this.
Gold: salbutamol inhaler PRN. Generated MED-001: PRN blue inhaler, which commonly refers to salbutamol; this is an acceptable match.
Gold: no known drug allergies. Generated ALLERGY-001: NKDA, which matches.
Gold: father had hypertension and died of bowel cancer. Generated FH-001 (father HTN) and FH-002 (father died from bowel cancer) together cover this.
Gold: mother has type 2 diabetes. Generated FH-003: mother has T2DM. Matches.
Gold: lives alone, software engineer. Generated SH-001 states the same.
Gold: non-smoker, social alcohol. Generated SH-002 (non-smoker) and SH-003 (drinks alcohol socially) together cover this.
Gold: impression is gastroenteritis. Generated ASM-001 diagnoses acute gastroenteritis, which matches.

Gold: supportive management with rest and increased fluids. Generated plan includes increased PO fluids (PLAN-002); rest is not mentioned but core element of fluids is present. Partially captured; rest is omitted but the fact as a whole is mostly reflected.
Gold: OTC oral rehydration solution (Dioralyte). Generated PLAN-001 recommends oral rehydration solution such as Dioralyte. Matches.

Gold: recommended regular paracetamol. Generated PLAN-003 recommends paracetamol PRN for fever/aches, which differs in dosing schedule (regular vs PRN). The gold 'regular' aspect is not captured; instead an alternative regimen is suggested, so the gold fact is not actually represented.
Gold: review in 7 days if not better. Generated PLAN-006 and FU-002: follow-up next week if no improvement, which aligns with 7 days.

Gold: advised earlier review if worsening symptoms including diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, reduced oral intake. Generated follow-up instructions (PLAN-005/FU-001) mention return if diarrhea >5 days, blood in stool, persistent fever, worsening symptoms—different and more specific red flags, not the same symptom list. The specific earlier-review triggers from Gold are not captured.

gen_assessment.reasoning: States 3-day history of watery diarrhea 5–6/day. Gold only notes that diarrhea has now developed with 5–6x/day and watery/loose stools; it does not specify a 3-day history, and timing differs ('now developed' vs 3 days). Thus, partially aligned but adds/changes timing details not in Gold.

Initial two episodes of vomiting now resolved. Gold indicates vomiting developed 3 days ago but does not specify only two episodes or that it has resolved. Extra temporal and quantitative detail not in Gold.
Decreased oral intake is explicitly in Gold (hpi-005), and reduced appetite is in hpi-006.
Gold hpi-007: patient feels weak. Same content.
Gold: no fever/temp. Generated: no current fever. Matches.
Gold: no headaches/muscle pain. Generated: denies headache or myalgia. Equivalent.
PRN blue inhaler is consistent with salbutamol PRN; no conflict with Gold.
No physical exam section appears in Gold facts; stating that no vitals/exam findings are provided is not supported or contradicted by Gold and represents meta-commentary beyond the Gold content.

Gold assessment only states 'gastroenteritis'. Generated fact specifies 'acute', links it to 3 days of watery diarrhea, and states mild dehydration and absence of red-flag features. Diagnosis label is supported (asm-001), but descriptors (acute, duration, mild dehydration, no red flags) add details not in Gold.
Gold only documents asthma in PMH; there is no assessment of stability or intermittent PRN use in the Assessment section. This is additional interpretive detail.
Gold plan includes increased fluids; generated plan encourages increased PO fluids, which is consistent with the fluids component of supportive management.

Gold plan-003 recommends regular paracetamol. Generated plan-003 recommends paracetamol PRN (as needed). These are opposite dosing strategies (scheduled vs as needed), so this contradicts the Gold plan.
Advice about being off work until 24–48 h diarrhea-free is not mentioned anywhere in Gold facts; it is an added management recommendation.

Generated red-flag return criteria (diarrhea >5 days, blood in stool, persistent fever, worsening symptoms) differ from and go beyond Gold's early-review criteria (worsening diarrhea, vomiting, abdo pain, reduced oral intake). These are additional and different instructions, not supported by Gold.
Follow-up next week if no improvement is consistent with Gold 'review in 7 days if not better'.
Instruction to continue PRN inhaler for asthma is not present in Gold plan; Gold only lists salbutamol PRN as a current medication without explicit continuation advice.

These follow-up criteria (diarrhea >5 days, blood in stool, persistent fever, worsening symptoms) are not the same as Gold FU-002, which focuses on worsening diarrhea, vomiting, abdo pain, reduced intake. The specific thresholds and symptoms are added, not directly supported.
